metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Traps and Shoulder Pain in 30 SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to relieve upper trapezius and shoulder pain at home.

These exercises will focus on lengthening and (more importantly) strengthening muscles in this area, which may give both quick and long-lasting tightness and pain relief.

Each exercise works a little differently, so to get the best results, go through them all and use what works best for you.

As a bonus, they can all be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give pain relief within seconds.

Watch now and get rid of traps and shoulder pain! 

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:44 Upper Trap Release
3:28 30 Second Shrug
5:29 Y Lift-Off
7:16 Instant Relief Stretches
